summary:
Fixed the v2 API compatibility regression in [models.go](/app/app/models.go): `UserV2` now includes `avatar_url`, `bio`, and `location`, and `ToV2()` preserves those values from `InternalUser`.

Verification: `./test.sh` passes.

Note: `test.sh` rebuilds `/app/server`, so `git status` shows `server` modified along with `app/models.go`.
